newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU publishes rule ending weekly wheat export tax.
newsitem.headline: EU publishes rule ending weekly wheat export tax.

text.p: The European Union published in the Official Journal on Wednesday a regulation ending taxes for soft wheat at weekly export tenders.
It means that traders will be able to bid for subsidies at the weekly export tender on Thursday, a Commission grain official said.

The EU imposed taxes on wheat exports last December after world prices soared above EU levels for the first time in 20 years. But after hitting record highs in April, the market has fallen sharply, mainly due to a recovery in production.
The abolition of the weekly tax was contained in Regulation (EC) No 1796/96 of 17 September 1996.
Earlier on Wednesday, another Commission official said the regulation might be published on Friday.
This will scrap the standing wheat export tax of 10 Ecus per tonne payable through an alternative daily channel.
